calx, calcis f.

noun, third declension

Lewis & Short: the goal of a race-course, “anciently marked with lime or chalk; opp. carcerēs, the starting-point”. It is feminine, like calx, lime.

Other words

  • crēta, crētae f.

    noun, first declension · also used · classical · Plin. NH 8.160 (Lewis & Short); Traupman 47, 51; Traupman 322

    Chalk, “for marking the goal in a race-course” (Lewis & Short).

Examples

  • calcem (crētam) attingere

    reach the finish lineTraupman 51

See also race, track.
